goal: Restore CI stability within two working days while maintaining strict product linting rules.

tasks.name: ESLint Policy & Overrides
tasks.description: Scope React lint enforcement to product code and quiet test/worker noise.

subTasks.name: Configure ESLint overrides
microTasks: Add override for src/worker/** enabling serviceworker env and disabling React rules
Add override for **/__tests__/** and **/*.test.* disabling display-name, unescaped-entities, exhaustive-deps
Retain strict rules for product code

subTasks.name: Document rule posture
microTasks: Draft ADR outlining contexts and acceptable suppressions
Capture list of rules considered non-negotiable

subTasks.name: Run lint baseline
microTasks: Execute next lint to capture remaining product violations
Export lint findings for remediation tracking

tasks.acceptance: npm run lint shows only product-code errors after overrides.

tasks.name: Product Remediations
tasks.description: Resolve lint violations in shipping code without changing behavior.

subTasks.name: Client boundary fixes
microTasks: Insert 'use client' in files that use hooks or router APIs
Verify server-only files remain unaffected

subTasks.name: React lint clean-up
microTasks: Add display names for exported components
Escape JSX literals flagged by react/no-unescaped-entities
Resolve exhaustive-deps warnings via memoization or justified suppressions

tasks.acceptance: next lint passes with zero errors; smoke tests succeed.

tasks.name: Runner Convergence
tasks.description: Ensure Jest is the sole unit-test runner.

subTasks.name: Remove Vitest usage
microTasks: Replace Vitest imports in zero-network guarantee tests with Jest APIs
Search repo for remaining Vitest references

tasks.acceptance: npm test runs without Vitest CJS import errors.

tasks.name: Test Stabilization
tasks.description: Repair failing suites with robust selectors and centralized mocks.

subTasks.name: Selector hardening
microTasks: Update SyncPanel tests to role-first queries
Add approved data-testid anchors (max five)
Adjust PWA/toast tests to avoid brittle text

subTasks.name: Mock consolidation
microTasks: Centralize navigator.serviceWorker, Notification, PushManager mocks in jest.setup.js
Ensure fetch/TextEncoder/polyfills are defined once

tasks.acceptance: Jest suite passes twice consecutively without flaky failures.

tasks.name: Pre-commit & CI Hardening
tasks.description: Speed up local checks and pin CI runtime.

subTasks.name: Pre-commit
microTasks: Install lint-staged running ESLint + tsc --noEmit on staged files
Update Husky pre-commit hook to invoke lint-staged

subTasks.name: CI pipeline
microTasks: Pin Node 22.15 in workflow and echo versions
Order jobs: SW guard ? lint ? typecheck ? Jest (? build on main)

tasks.acceptance: Pre-commit completes in =5s; CI finishes =7m with Node version logged.

tasks.name: Governance & Documentation

subTasks.name: Docs
microTasks: Publish ADR with lint contexts and suppression policy
Update testing guide with selector hierarchy and mock list
Refresh README with Jest-only runner, Node version, quickstart

subTasks.name: Evidence pack
microTasks: Capture before/after lint counts and test timings
List files receiving 'use client' and any eslint disables

tasks.acceptance: Documentation merged; evidence pack ready for release archive.
